lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: 15 user-facing RUNTIME remediation strings still instruct the retired command

openQuestions: Fixed the story's exact 16 enumerated remediation strings PLUS: the 6 'bootstrapping cam run...' narration lines that immediately precede an already-fixed remediation string in the same bootstrap-failure block (plan/ship/next/review/issue/spec.ts), the two unlisted 'Run `cam run` manually and retry.' duplicates in issue.ts/spec.ts (same function as an already-listed sibling), and run.ts's 'run `cam init` first' two lines below the one enumerated run.ts line. All now read `gship <subcommand>`.

Deliberately NOT fixed (same defect class, different command handlers the story never opened -- flagged for a future story rather than silently expanded into): drain.ts:108,119,122 ('Run `cam drain --clear/--stop`...'), resume.ts's `emitEntry('cam next', ...)` + the noop-case 'the retry-monitor will respawn `cam next`...' hint, and next.ts:193's writeState helper ('run `cam stop` to clear', thrown as an Error, not currently covered by any test).

Deliberately NOT fixed (different class: an origin-labeling error prefix, not a typed-remediation instruction -- same class as the already out-of-scope `[cam retry-monitor]`/`[cam]` internal-log-identity convention flagged in US-R2-001's handoff): prune.ts's 'cam prune: <detail>' prefixes (4 sites) and spec.ts's 'cam spec --write-docs: <detail>' / 'cam spec --persist: <detail>' prefixes (5 sites).

Deliberately NOT fixed: every emitTitle('cam <subcommand>') banner across all commands -- a systemic, all-commands cosmetic-identity convention (not an instruction to type anything), out of scope for this story and much larger than a single-story rename.
nextStoryContext: The 16 story-enumerated runtime remediation strings (plus the immediately-adjacent narration/duplicate lines in the same code blocks) now say `gship <subcommand>` instead of `cam <subcommand>`. test/attach-hint.test.ts's toContain('cam run')/not.toContain('cam run') assertions were updated to 'gship run' in the same commit -- they test emitAttachHint's real output, not a hardcoded fixture, so any further runtime-string rename in this family must update this test in the same commit too. Full `bun run check:all` is green: 5992 pass / 0 fail, typecheck clean, lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all ok; no vendor/templates files touched. Next non-operator, passes:false story by priority is US-R2-003 (priority 3): WARNING about `${{ github.ref_name }}` interpolated directly into a `run:` shell step (script-injection risk) -- see openQuestions above for the deferred remediation-string sites (drain.ts, resume.ts, next.ts writeState) a future story could pick up as its own scoped cleanup.
